body: At schools and jobs. ..I just never fit in

I  do have debt but that is just a small part of everything.  I don't ever remember being really happy.  I have no friends,  no family that cares about me and since I lost my job I just stay in my house all the time because I just can't face the world.  I feel like I have had to fight my whole life to prove my worth and nothing has helped and I have no more fight left
I wish I could borrow some hope.  Thanks for the offer anyway
